traditional: Sudden change rips the familiar bandage off the crooked-healed place.

modern.blend: Disruption and release land at once; what got uncovered was waiting for exactly this.
modern.harmonious: The shock that frees something; healing arrives sideways and unscheduled.
modern.hard: The disruption exposes what the routine was protecting before anyone is ready.
modern.business: Reorgs and pivots hit old injuries; separate the change from the wound it touched.
